summary: Houses 8-10 m from the kerb along a no-stopping bend.
reasons: Dwellings 8-10 m away along the stretch

drivers.seclusion: Houses front the south kerb for the whole length; bush is on the opposite side only.
drivers.access_and_room: Narrow kerb on a curving through road; no verge or pull-in to stop clear of the lane.
drivers.traffic: Through road with painted centre line; moving traffic, no parked cars along this kerb.
drivers.convention: No Stopping Any Time sign mapped at the kerb; no cars seen parked here.

flags: Steep in places: max about 6% grade, mean 2.6%
Low-lying: min elevation about 7 m, Witton Creek 35 m away
sun_shade: Open kerb; bush to the north and east gives some shade at the top end.
